assessment.rationale: Hitchens makes the citation attempt readily reconstructable by identifying an author, book, publisher, Jerusalem High Court, Haaretz coverage, and rabbinical courts. Precision remains limited because he does not reproduce or closely specify the ruling, and the relationship between the secular court and rabbinical courts is compressed and ambiguous; the cited source also does not itself establish that the legal account is correct. Transcription uncertainty in names and titles is not penalized.
